name: ClipLint independent synthetic adversarial evaluation v1
disclaimer: All people, episodes and factual scenarios are synthetic. This small challenge set is not representative and cannot establish real-world accuracy, safety, or editorial correctness.
creation_method: Authored and labels fixed independently before reading or executing the implementation. Gold labels are semantic requirements, not a list of rules known to be implemented.
clip_range_semantics: Half-open source-time intervals in listed playback order. Whole cues are used except explicitly tagged partial-cue abstention cases.

label_ontology.numeric_mismatch: A numeric value, magnitude, unit, relation, or role asserted by title/copy conflicts with supplied source context.
label_ontology.omitted_condition: A necessary qualification, scope, exception, hedge, or causal limitation is removed, creating a materially stronger/different claim.
label_ontology.negation_reversal: A source negation or explicitly rejected stance is reversed by title/copy or chosen content.
label_ontology.unsupported_quote: Material presented as a direct quotation is not supported by the attributed source utterance, after harmless formatting normalization.
label_ontology.misattribution: A claim or stance is falsely assigned to a named speaker; reporting a claim is not endorsing it.
label_ontology.misleading_splice: Discontinuous selection or reordering removes or changes a meaning-critical relationship between passages.
label_ontology.incomplete_reference: The selected transcript has an unresolved textual reference or unfinished meaning-critical clause.
label_ontology.insufficient_evidence: Available text/timing/speaker metadata cannot establish the requested conclusion; avoid affirmative certification and identify the limit.
